tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.8.2
§ Gershom = "foreigner"
1) firstborn son of Moses and Zipporah
2) firstborn son of Levi
3) a son of the priestly family of Phinehas who returned from exile with Ezra

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Gereshom, the name of four Israelites
